name: Eternal Limited
summary: Eternal Limited, together with its subsidiaries, provides e-commerce platform services to restaurant partners, quick commerce merchants, delivery partners, theatres, sports facilities, event organizers, and users in India and internationally. The company operates through India Food Ordering and Delivery, Hyperpure Supplies (B2B Business), Quick Commerce, and Going Out segments.
